text:
Gold Price in 1976
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1976, the LBMA gold price rose 5.0% between 1976-01-30 ($128) and 1976-12-31 ($135). The highest sampled price was $135 in December and the lowest was $104 in August. The mean of these observations was $124. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
